description: A tall, slender floor lamp with a flared, pleated lampshade. The stem of the lamp is a white, cylindrical column that widens slightly at the base. Attached to the stem is a decorative element resembling a chain of beads or oval shapes, hanging down towards the base. The base itself is a simple, circular disc. The overall design is minimalist and elegant, with a focus on clean lines and a uniform color palette.
